as_told.title: Host travels to Peru and sees the tridactyl mummies

plain: In 2025, Michels says, he went to Peru and watched mummified bodies with three fingers and three toes being scanned, and came back saying "I just might have seen a dead alien" and that it "broke my brain a little bit." He tells it as something he saw himself, alongside the fellow witnesses Michael Mazzola and Ammar Kandil and a man named Brigham Buhler. He adds that forensic experts say the skulls show no sign of the head-binding rituals you would expect from the people of the region.
